title: Elden Ring Costs You $1 an Hour. Worth It?
caption:
Elden Ring is $59.99 on Steam and takes about 60 hours to beat (HowLongToBeat main story): $1 an hour. A $12 movie ticket for 2 hours is $6 an hour. Go 100% (136 hours) and it drops to 44 cents an hour. Our own math.
What's the best value game you've ever bought?

Sources: Steam store (US price), HowLongToBeat
ig_first_line: A movie costs you $6 an hour. Elden Ring costs $1. Go 100% and it's 44 cents.
